meaning.en: At this moment, at present, now.

sentences.en: My point here is that currently the planet is producing enough food to feed everyone on it.

sentences.en: Around the world, more than a billion mobile devices that both take and send photographs are currently in use, spread even to the poorest parts of the globe.

sentences.en: There is currently no recognized treatment for carbohydrate cravings.
